newsitem.title: USA: VIDAMED and Tenet offer new technology.
newsitem.headline: VIDAMED and Tenet offer new technology.

text.p: VIDAMED Inc and Tenet HealthSystem, a subsidiary of Tenet Healthcare Corp, said Monday they have entered into an agreement that will offer Tenet hospitals preferential access to a new technology for the treatment of prostate disease.

VIDAMED said its TransUrethral Needle Ablation, was recently cleared by the Food and Drug Administration for treating the symptoms associated with benign prostatic hyperplasia, a noncancerous enlargement of the prostate that restricts urine flow and affects an estimated 14 million men in the United States.
VIDAMED said it will provide educational training programs for Tenet-affiliated urologists and Tenet hospitals will have preferential access to purchase the system.
VIDAMED said it and Tenet will work together to create a database to track outcomes for one year post-operatively of at least 200 patients undergoing the procedure.
